_doc: Khuôn Reels (docs/specs/social-reels-templates.md): Ama/Carlos đọc mẫu tiếng Anh ≤150 wpm, chừa lặng cho người xem đọc theo (repeat), IPA lấy từ kho từ lúc dựng, chữ bản địa viết tay (native-qa).

mistake.en: Not knowing clear lines to share your opinion

items.native: 私はそうは思いません。

segments.text: Want to share your opinion? Here are four easy lines. Repeat after me.

native.hook: 意見を英語で言うには？
native.caption: 英語で自分の意見を言うのは難しい？この4つの表現を保存しよう。たとえば“I think so too.”と“I will think about it.”。Carlos先生の声を聞いて、間の時間に続けて言ってみよう。Lexkiteアプリでもっと練習できます。

en.hook: How do you share your opinion?
en.caption: Is it hard to share your opinion in English? Save these 4 lines, such as “I think so too.” and “I will think about it.” Listen to Carlos, then say each one in the pause. You can practice more in the Lexkite app.
